TATAPOWER: Borrowings rose Rs 17,500 cr in FY26 to fund a capex plan that has already slipped; leverage is rising while returns stay thin.
JIOFIN: A Rs 1.4-lakh-crore valuation still resting mostly on treasury income; the operating businesses are too young to carry the price.
DEEPAKNTR: A commodity downcycle name: FY22's peak margins have halved and the price still assumes the cycle returns quickly.
HINDCOPPER: FY26's profit boom is copper price, not mining volume; the capacity ramp is delayed and a PSU stake-sale overhang sits at a peak multiple.
RELIANCE: Bottom-quartile on quality and value with negative momentum; our own sum-of-the-parts sits at today's price, no bargain.
GAIL: Marketing margins are in a structural reset: five straight quarters of profit decline, and the dividend now exceeds free cash flow.
ULTRACEMCO: Priced at 42-46x earnings for a 10.7% ROE while cement pricing stays soft; no dated catalyst offsets it.
HINDUNILVR: Headline profit is demerger-inflated (organic growth ~4%); three-year revenue growth of 2% does not support the price.
LT: FY27 guidance has been cut and H1 execution guided soft; at ~32x trailing earnings there is little cushion, so we sell into strength.
ITCHOTELS: 44-46x trailing earnings on a 7% ROE with a promoter-stake overhang; one strong quarter does not yet earn the multiple.
